name: Simone Web: Super Admin – Security & Performance
author: Simone Manfredini

sections.description:
This plugin provides a set of tools to enhance your WordPress website’s performance and security. Key features include:

  • Removal of unnecessary WordPress metadata.
  • Disabling XML-RPC and emojis.
  • HTTPS redirection and caching rules.
  • Advanced user role management for administrators.
  • jQuery optimization.
  • Deflate compression and browser caching rules (Apache).

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under Settings → Simone Web: Super Admin (visible to super admins only).
sections.faq:
How do I enable HTTPS redirection?

Enable the “Redirect HTTPS” option in the plugin settings to automatically redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

Can I keep XML-RPC enabled?

Yes. XML-RPC is disabled by default; untick “Disable XML-RPC” in the Security tab if you need it (e.g. for the WordPress mobile app or Jetpack).

Can I disable theme and plugin editing for administrators?

Yes, you can disable file editing for non-super admin users by enabling the “Disable File Edit” option in the settings.

Why are the .htaccess rules not applied?

They need Apache and a permalink structure other than “Plain”. On Nginx, add the equivalent rules to the server configuration. The plugin shows a notice in these cases.

What happens when I deactivate or delete the plugin?

On deactivation the plugin’s rules are removed from .htaccess. On deletion all plugin options are removed, together with the capabilities the plugin stored on users.
